text: In add_numbers, why do you use return a + b?
key_ideas: a + b adds the two input numbers
return sends the sum back to the caller
Printing a value is different from returning it
model_answer: a + b adds the two numbers. return sends that sum back to the code that called the function, so it can use the answer. Printing would only display it.
